title: Dictionary pages belong to a sequence of column names
summary: The Parquet reader kept the literal field a.b distinct from b nested under a. Reading the changed nested dictionary twice around the unchanged top-level dictionary preserved both identities.

change.description: The Parquet reader keys column metadata and dictionary pages by individual path components. A literal dot inside a field name retains its identity.

notes: The pin's compiled DictionaryPageReader precedes the same Parquet 1.18.2/Hadoop dependencies on both sides. The complete pinned module needs Thrift 0.23.0.
With identical compiled caller bytes, 1.18.1 matched the parent and 1.18.2 matched the landing on all three histories.
